天衍 is an open-source infrastructure project building an on-device Linux runtime and autonomous agents. With Custom Iteration you can ask the 天衍 AI on your phone to modify 天衍 itself, compile a standalone 天衍Dev APK automatically through GitHub Actions in the cloud, and contribute back to the community.
A dedicated path ~/custom_tianyan keeps every change physically isolated from the host environment.
Ships the tianyan-custom-iteration Skill so the agent follows the multi-module, Compose and safety rules.
Skip heavy on-phone compilation and get a standalone 天衍Dev (top.tianyan.app.dev) APK automatically.
Dual-flavor coexistence and open-source PR loop
The dev build coexists with the release app, and once verified you can open a standard PR in one step.
